Hart Info

Source:

Description

Information about the hart currently selected by hartsel. Optional; reads all-zero if not present. Entire register is read-only.

Field Descriptions

_reserved_31_24

Reserved.

nscratch

Number of dscratch registers available for debugger use during program buffer execution (dscratch0 upwards).

_reserved_19_17

Reserved.

dataaccess

0: Data registers (dataN) are shadowed by CSRs. 1: Data registers are shadowed in hart's memory map.

datasize

If dataaccess=0: Number of CSRs for dataN. If dataaccess=1: Number of 32-bit words in memory map for dataN. Max value 12.

dataaddr

If dataaccess=0: Number of first CSR for dataN. If dataaccess=1: Signed address of RAM where dataN are shadowed (relative to zero).
